🇲🇽🏭 MEXICO IMPORTS HIT ALL-TIME RECORD — $54B IN FACTORY INPUTS

INEGI data: Mexico's imports surged to a record $67.5 billion in April, driven by $54.2 billion in intermediate goods — up 29.8% year-over-year. Non-petroleum intermediate imports jumped 31.9%.

The trade surplus hit $4.52 billion — nine times the Bloomberg consensus estimate.

Nearshoring isn't arriving with ribbon-cutting ceremonies. It's arriving on cargo ships — measured in tens of billions of dollars of raw materials and components feeding Mexico's factory floors.

🚨🇮🇷 US BOMBS SOUTHERN IRAN DURING PEACE TALKS — CEASEFIRE VIOLATED

While Iranian delegates landed in Doha for peace negotiations, US forces struck missile sites and vessels in southern Iran. IRGC members were killed.

CENTCOM called it "self-defense attacks to protect our soldiers." Iran's Foreign Ministry called it a "flagrant violation" of the April 8 ceasefire.

Trump, meanwhile, said negotiations were "progressing satisfactorily" — and demanded Iran ship its enriched uranium to the US for disposal.

Bombing a country while negotiating peace with it. The empire's definition of diplomacy.

🇲🇽🏫 CDMX SCREENS 1.1 MILLION STUDENTS — 150+ SUICIDES PREVENTED

Mexico City's "Vida Plena, Corazón Contento" program screened 1,149,951 adolescents across 1,116 public schools in its first year. Result: 579 mental health emergencies addressed, more than 150 suicide cases identified and intervened.

225 specialists make bi-weekly visits covering anxiety, depression, sexual violence, and substance use. Female students showed more than double the rates of anxiety and depression compared to males.

"Mental health is not a private matter to be carried alone under stigma — it is a collective responsibility and government obligation."

🔥🇲🇽 SHEINBAUM TO ALITO MORENO: "RETURN WHAT YOU STOLE"

Sheinbaum didn't mince words on PRI leader Alejandro "Alito" Moreno: "Que regrese lo robado."

The FGR has been investigating Moreno since 2022 for illicit enrichment during his time as Campeche governor. In July 2025, state prosecutors requested Congress strip his immunity over 83 million pesos in alleged embezzlement.

Sheinbaum's position: recovering stolen public resources matters more than a political desafuero spectacle. "There can be extinction of domain, many things, if the person does not want to return it."

The PRI leader responded by crying persecution. Classic.

🚨🇲🇽 6,200 MIGRANT CHILDREN CAGED UNDER TRUMP — 10X BIDEN LEVELS

The Marshall Project reports 6,200+ children have been imprisoned since Trump's second term began. On any given day, 226 kids are behind bars — ten times the average under Biden.

More than 1,600 have been caged for over 20 days, violating the 1997 Flores settlement. Over 205,000 minors have had at least one parent detained. And 1,000+ children separated during Trump's first term still haven't been reunited with their families.

This isn't border security. It's state-organized cruelty against children, documented and quantified.

🚨🇨🇺 US PLANS ATTACK ON CUBA NEXT WEEK — PUERTO RICO GOVERNOR SAYS IT OUT LOUD

Puerto Rico's governor Jenniffer González just said the quiet part out loud: "We had a war with Venezuela the other day, and we're going to have one with Cuba next week."

She wasn't leaking intelligence — she was bragging. Arguing for statehood, she called Puerto Rico a "key strategic axis in the pharmaceutical and military supply chain" of the United States.

This while the DOJ indicts 94-year-old Raúl Castro for a 1996 incident, and the USS Nimitz carrier strike group sits in the Caribbean.

The empire doesn't hide its plans anymore. It campaigns on them.

LATIN TIMES: Mexican-Linked Meth Labs in South Africa Signal Cartel Shift Into Africa
May 26, 2026 | 🟡

📰 Five Mexican nationals arrested in a meth lab raid in North West province, South Africa. 481 kg seized. Latin Times frames a successful international bust as cartels "conquering" a new continent. South Africa's meth crisis predates any Mexican involvement by decades — not mentioned.

Fourth lab "with suspected Mexican links" since 2024 — out of hundreds of meth labs busted across South Africa in that period. The story is cooperation working. The headline sells dread.

• "Signal cartel shift into Africa"
• "No longer just moving drugs through Africa but producing them there"

MOODY'S/BLOOMBERG: Moody's Cuts Mexico to Baa3, Last Rung of Investment Grade
May 20, 2026 | 🟡

📰 Moody's downgrades Mexico citing "structural fiscal deficits" and $35B in Pemex support. Financial press ran it as mismanagement. US tariffs on steel, aluminum, and auto exports squeezing Mexican revenues — barely mentioned. Mexico's MX$5.6 trillion infrastructure plan (2026-2030) went uncovered by the same outlets.

Two days later Mexico signed an EU trade deal eliminating tariffs on 99% of products. Not one downgrade article mentioned it.

• "$35 billion directed to Pemex in 2025" — cited as reckless
• $41.6B in new infrastructure investment for 2026 — not cited at all

GIS REPORTS: Cartel Evolution Fuels Mexico's Managed Instability
May 26, 2026 | 🟡

📰 A private intelligence CEO introduces "managed instability" as Mexico's default setting — too weak to win, too present to collapse. Three scenarios for security; none include "the strategy is working." Homicides down 40%, 52,000 arrests — not mentioned once.

The author's company sells security consulting. Mexico is framed as permanently behind.

• "Neither the state nor criminal organizations achieve decisive dominance"
• "Criminal organizations have adapted faster than state structures"

NY POST: Serial Killer Fears Grow as Three Women Are Murdered in Puerto Vallarta
May 25, 2026 | 🔴

📰 Three women murdered in PV and NY Post runs "serial killer fears" in a "paradise loved by Americans" — two weeks before the World Cup. Officials say no confirmed link between cases. The article weaves in February cartel violence from three months ago for maximum anxiety.

The victims were Mexican women, not tourists. But the framing centers American feelings about a Mexican city.

• "May have a serial killer on the loose"
• "Popular resort town for American tourists" — the victims' nationality is an afterthought
